requirements.text: Patients should be able to book, cancel, or reschedule appointments online.
Patients should be able to request their repeat prescriptions online.
Patients should have secure online access to test results after clinician review.
The system must ensure compliance with GDPR and maintain data security while being accessible to all patients.
Patients should be able to see available time slots for both GP and nurse appointments and filter by type or clinician.
Patients should receive immediate confirmation of booked appointments, with options for reminders via email or text.
There should be a straightforward process for canceling or rescheduling appointments, with a confirmation message for any changes made.
There needs to be a clear pathway for urgent appointment requests, allowing patients to communicate their needs for same-day appointments.
The portal must integrate seamlessly with existing practice management software to ensure synchronized appointment records.
Patients should have a dedicated section in the portal where they can view their current medications and easily select medications for reorder.
Patients should be able to see a history of their previous prescriptions.
Safeguards must be in place to prevent requests for medications that haven’t been authorized by the clinician.
There should be a workflow for staff to efficiently review submitted requests, including notifications for new requests.
Patients should receive confirmation notifications about the status of their prescription requests.
Robust identity verification measures must be in place to ensure security and compliance with GDPR during the prescription request process.
Patients should only access test results after they have been reviewed and authorized by a clinician.
Patients should receive a notification (via email or text) when their test results are ready to view.
There should be a clear and user-friendly section in the portal for viewing results, presented in an easy-to-understand format.
Patients should be able to submit questions or seek clarification about their results directly through the portal.
Strong identity verification steps must be in place to ensure that only authorized patients can access their results.
Data encryption must be implemented during transmission and at rest to protect patient data and ensure compliance with GDPR.
Regular security audits must be conducted to identify and address potential vulnerabilities.
The portal must conform to accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG 2.1 AA) to ensure usability for all patients.
There should be a straightforward onboarding process with easy-to-follow tutorials or guides to help patients navigate the portal.
There should be a dedicated support line for patients needing extra assistance.
